data.question: What is the maximum period allowed for a student to fulfill all requirements of the Bachelor of the Science of Engineering Honours degree?
data.answer: Maximum Period: 8 academic years. From the By-laws (Section 9.0 - Award of the Degree):A student shall be eligible for the conferment of the degree in Bachelor of the Science of Engineering Honours after the successful completion of all the stipulated requirements in section 7 within a maximum period of eight academic years from the date of the first registration to the faculty.Notes: - Normally, eligibility for a class (e.g., First Class) requires completion within 4 academic years (Section 8.1). - Extensions beyond 4 years may be granted under extenuating circumstances (Section 8.4), but the absolute maximum is 8 years.
data.By ground_truth: A student must fulfill all requirements within eight academic years from the date of enrolment.

data.question: Who is responsible for preparing the draft academic calendar, including examination dates?
data.answer: Registrar (with concurrence of the Dean)  From the Exam Manual (Section 1.1.2 - Calendar of Dates): The draft calendar for the academic year inclusive of the dates of examinations shall be prepared by the Registrar with the concurrence of the Dean. The Faculty Board shall approve the academic calendar. Additional Context: - The Registrar is the overall in-charge of examinations under the Dean's direction (Section on Registrar's responsibilities). - Approval must be obtained one month prior to the academic year (1.1.3), and revisions require notice or Senate approval in emergencies (1.1.4).
data.Exa ground_truth: The Registrar, with the concurrence of the Dean, is responsible for preparing the draft academic calendar.

data.question: When was the Faculty of Engineering, University of Ruhuna established, and when was the first batch admitted?
data.answer: Established: 1st July 1999 First batch admitted: 27th March 2000 From the Student Handbook (Chapter 2.1 - Introduction):The Faculty of Engineering of University of Ruhuna was established on 1st July 1999 at Hapugala, Galle. First batch of students was admitted on 27th March 2000.
data.hand ground_truth: The Faculty of Engineering was established on 1st July 1999, and the first batch of students was admitted on 27th March 2000.
